items.source: Warning: @Commit can be used as direct replacement for @Rollback(false); however, it should not be declared alongside @Rollback. Declaring @Commit and @Rollback on the same test method or on the same test class is unsupported and may lead to unpredictable results.
items.translation: 警告：@Commit 可直接替代 @Rollback(false)；但是，不应与 @Rollback 一起声明。在同一测试方法或同一测试类上同时声明 @Commit 和 @Rollback 不受支持，并可能导致不可预测的结果。

items.source: Consult the class-level Javadoc for TransactionalTestExecutionListener for an explanation of test-managed transactions.
items.translation: Consult the class-level Javadoc for TransactionalTestExecutionListener 以了解测试管理的交易的解释。

items.source: When declared as a class-level annotation, @Commit defines the default commit semantics for all test methods within the test class hierarchy or nested class hierarchy. When declared as a method-level annotation, @Commit defines commit semantics for the specific test method, potentially overriding class-level default commit or rollback semantics.
items.translation: 当声明为类级别注解时，`@Commit` 定义了测试类层次结构或嵌套类层次结构中所有测试方法的默认提交语义。当声明为方法级别注解时，`@Commit` 定义特定测试方法的提交语义，可能会覆盖类级别的默认提交或回滚语义。

items.source: This annotation will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此注解将从外部测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅 @NestedTestConfiguration。
